title: Multiverse of Greatness: Generating Story Branches with LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Collecting all words used in the generated games, applying standard text pre-processing, and analyzing word frequencies using word clouds and bar charts to identify overrepresented vocabulary resulting from the LLM's training data distribution.
Counting the number of occurrences of positive and negative words across the generated games using a predefined sentiment word list to determine if the LLM leans towards a specific sentiment.
